steps.title: Send the brief
steps.detail: Email a short description of the job and, if possible, a sample file.

steps.title: Receive a fixed quote
steps.detail: You get a written quote with the price, deadline and scope before any work starts.

steps.title: Pay the deposit
steps.detail: A 50% deposit starts the work, by PayPal or by EFT for South African clients. The balance is due on delivery.

link.label: PayPal, once a quote is accepted

steps.title: Review and revise
steps.detail: You review the result. The revision rounds in your quote cover changes needed to match the agreed brief.

responseNote: Replies usually within one working day.
